purpose: Exhaustive reusable-foundation extraction and toolkit integration review

availableConversations.additionalEarlierQualityConversation: All 58 accessible turns read through the app's conversation API
availableConversations.limits: Archives include automated continuations; entries are not counted as unique human requests. This does not claim access to every historic or deleted chat.

method: Enumerated every tracked path plus present untracked candidates; read/parsed all recognized text files for headings, exports, test names and reliability markers.
Inspected all reachable commit subjects/dates and file-change history; followed foundation-related historical diffs into current source.
Reviewed every feature/module family for a reusable behavior, conditional recipe, existing coverage or explicit exclusion.
Reviewed toolkit contracts, installed skill paths, source recipes, templates, scaffolds, runnable shell, workflow configuration and tests.
Cross-checked historical preferences against current implementation and separated work-in-progress from verified patterns.
Verified the integrated toolkit and a freshly generated example; excluded private transcripts, source branding/data and temporary review artifacts from publication.

coverage.disposition: Retain thin routes, module APIs, typed adapters and documented retirement; verify generated app against installed rules.

coverage.area: Shared controls, layout, typography and visual character
coverage.disposition: Generic compact hierarchy and functional/expressive type roles; brand tokens and artwork remain app-owned.
Working reduced-motion/presence recipes with interruption tests; contextual delight and visible gesture alternatives.

coverage.area: Navigation, keyboard, overlays and retained screens
coverage.disposition: Conditional sticky controls, context restoration, modal return focus, inactive-screen isolation and narrow-width checks.

coverage.area: Lifecycle, drafts, completion, identity and history
coverage.disposition: Optional recipes and stable-data rules; do not copy domain calculations or default confirmation values.

coverage.area: Storage, migrations, recovery, backup and deletion
coverage.disposition: Preserve corrupt data, block writes after failed reload, test real-engine upgrades and define deletion/restore coverage.

coverage.area: Accounts, guest migration, browser ownership and sync
coverage.disposition: Conditional ownership, durable intents, pagination/conflicts, safe handover and cleanup guidance; no default backend.

coverage.area: Device permissions, media, voice, notifications and sharing
coverage.disposition: Injected optional adapters, contextual permission, temporary-resource ownership and honest completion states.

coverage.area: Discovery, catalogue, location, pricing and external content
coverage.disposition: Generic identity/freshness/rights/capability and bounded-provider rules; no domain registries or location datasets.
Optional recipes with meaningful eligibility, undo, stale-target and accessibility checks; no default campaigns/gamification.
Disabled-by-default allowlisted boundaries, consent lifecycle and actual payload verification; vendor/product policy app-owned.
Measured budgets, runtime dependency review, realistic lists and stable layouts; preserve useful design and content.

coverage.area: Tests, release, CI, updates and store evidence
coverage.disposition: Change-sensitive checks, clean generated-app proof, exact artifact reporting and manual native compilation workflow.
Single kickoff, canonical guide/source parity, honest review coverage, commit/push/readback and owned cleanup.

coverage.area: Domain models, provider fixtures, artwork, marketing and historical artifacts
coverage.disposition: Inventory/text-scan where applicable; deliberately excluded from generic source extraction.

findings.issue: Scattered kickoff guidance made motion and recovery easy to overlook
findings.resolution: One start-here checklist connected to both agent paths and app-baseline records.

findings.issue: Source recipes lacked a proven integrated creation path
findings.resolution: Existing shell work integrated; clean generation, actual workflow and release limits verified.

findings.issue: Motion exits and preference races needed behavioral protection
findings.resolution: Interruption-safe presence, live reduced motion, persisted preferences and focused checks.

findings.issue: Previously hydrated stores could overwrite unreadable data after a failed reload
findings.resolution: Preference/flag reloads become non-writable; success-failure-write-recovery regressions.

findings.issue: Notification duplicate protection discarded different queued intents
findings.resolution: Serialize distinct intents and deduplicate only consecutive equivalent operations.

findings.issue: Equivalent-read coalescing and lossless-write ordering were easy to confuse
findings.resolution: Small serial queue recipe with order/rejection tests and explicit contract guidance.

findings.issue: Public guides and installed references drifted
findings.resolution: Canonical synchronization/check covers mirrored guides and selected executable sources.

findings.issue: Generated app violated installed route/formatting rules
findings.resolution: Thin route re-exports and formatted shared checks included in generator source.

findings.issue: Potential feature growth blurred optional guidance and working code
findings.resolution: Catalogue states applicability and implementation limits; no automatic providers/features.

findings.issue: SDK package mismatches and inherited dependency findings
findings.resolution: Compatible package/lock updates, 21/21 Expo Doctor checks, unresolved upstream audit paths explicitly retained as a release gap.

limits: This is exhaustive for repository inventory, reachable history, available conversation records and reusable-foundation disposition; automated traversal is not a claim that every line/image was manually audited.
Not an exhaustive vulnerability scan, production deployment, signed-native-device or OTA acceptance.
Source-product local changes are preserved and never committed or deleted by this task.
Raw private review ledgers/transcripts and temporary apps are removed after remote delivery verification.
